SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.Name: Feature request
SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.Description: Describe a new feature clearly for AI or a maintainer.
SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.Content: Please read docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. I need a new feature: [description]. Scope: [in/out]. Acceptance criteria: [list]. Suggest a compact implementation plan and the tests that should run.
SeedPrompt.BugReport.Name: Bug report
SeedPrompt.BugReport.Description: Capture the bug, repro steps, and expected behavior.
SeedPrompt.BugReport.Content: The bug happens in module: [module]. Repro steps: [steps]. Current result: [actual]. Expected result: [expected]. Find the root cause, fix it in the correct layer, and add tests if needed.
SeedPrompt.MaintenanceHandoff.Name: Maintenance handoff
SeedPrompt.MaintenanceHandoff.Descriptio: Hand over module context to the next maintainer.
SeedPrompt.MaintenanceHandoff.Content: Summarize module [module name]: goal, controller, service, entity, related views, data flow, editing risks, and a post-change test checklist.
SeedPrompt.CodeReview.Name: Code review
SeedPrompt.CodeReview.Description: Review changes with a focus on bugs, risks, and test coverage.
SeedPrompt.CodeReview.Content: Review this change in priority order: bugs, security, user isolation, validation, migrations, and test gaps. If nothing is wrong, call out the remaining risks.
